items.title: China, U.S. agree to $30 billion tariff cut, launch AI dialogue
items.summary: Investing.com -- China and the U.S. have agreed to a $30 billion reciprocal tariff-reduction arrangement and to launch dialogue on AI, under an eight-point consensus reached during Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to the U.S., China’s foreign ministry said on Saturday.
